target: office workers who buy lunch on workdays
price_for: one lunch delivered to the desk

behaviours.name: Brings lunch from home
behaviours.how: Packs a box most mornings and eats at the desk.

behaviours.name: Orders on a food app
behaviours.how: Opens an app around noon and picks whatever has an offer.

behaviours.name: Eats at the canteen
behaviours.how: Walks down with colleagues and takes the set plate.

objections: New food services are good for a month and then the quality drops.
I do not want to pay for a whole month up front.
My lunch time moves around with meetings.
I have never heard of this company.
habits: Decides what to eat at the last minute.
Tracks every rupee spent on food.
Eats with the same two colleagues every day.
Skips lunch when work is busy.
